About.title: About me
About.lead: Career changer with a real track record: RS School top 1 among ~12,000, two years of hands-on AI-assisted development and a set of built and deployed systems.
paragraphs: My path into development started with a strong signal: after finishing my degree in Economic Cybernetics (ZAB-recognized bachelor), I placed 1st among roughly 12,000 participants in the RS School / EPAM prep course.
Instead of enrolling in the follow-up bootcamp, I chose self-directed learning — roadmap.sh (2023–2024) and from 2024 onwards an intensive AI-augmented workflow.
Today I build web apps, Telegram bots, REST APIs and automation systems — with AI as a tool. I understand what I build and can maintain and explain it.

About.motivationTitle: What a team gets from me
motivationPoints: I deliver working solutions — no perfectionism at the expense of shipping.
I learn fast, ask when I'm stuck, and communicate clearly about my current level.
AI-augmented workflow is my default: I ship faster than a classic junior and I'm honest about what I know and don't know.
